name: Falkland Islands (Malvinas)

findings.summary: The Falkland Islands Government settled with exclusive licensee Sure South Atlantic, agreeing compensation of up to £6.167m for lost broadband revenue, clearing the regulator to license Starlink satellite broadband, previously used unofficially, for homes and businesses.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 4 as a licence issued; the FIG statement says the regulator will license Starlink and ISPreview reports the licence granted. The £6.167m is a compensation ceiling to Sure, not the value of the Starlink licence, so values null. Not reconfirmed in force at run date, so still_current null.

findings.controller: Intelsat (now part of SES, Luxembourg) with OneWeb (Eutelsat) LEO capacity
findings.summary: Intelsat and Sure South Atlantic signed an expanded agreement under which Intelsat's managed AgileCore service, combining its GEO satellites with OneWeb LEO capacity, carries Sure's 4G, broadband, Wi-Fi and government traffic in the Falklands, which lack undersea fibre.
findings.analyst_inference: Satellite backhaul is the territory's sole external link, so the managed-service operator is treated as controller. Intelsat was US-headquartered at signing but Luxembourg-domiciled and has since been absorbed into SES (Luxembourg); OneWeb is Eutelsat (France/UK). Pole third is a judgement a reviewer may revisit. Date taken from the release ID. Both sources are Intelsat's own, so not independent.

findings.summary: FIDC launched Project T-1000, a small set of controlled internal AI pilots for document search, enquiry handling, administration and data analysis, supported by Adapto South Atlantic, alongside a survey of AI use by Falklands organisations.
findings.analyst_inference: The release names no AI provider or model, so controller and pole are null rather than guessed. Coded as a tier-2 pilot at municipal scale because it is internal to one statutory body.

facilities.null_reason: one search found no data-centre or AI-campus project in the Falklands; territory has no undersea fibre

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchase or deployment surfaced in other searches

applications.null_reason: two searches found only a 2023 Police Committee discussion of CCTV in Stanley with no decision, funding or vendor; no surveillance or e-government AI system

research_gaps: Radio and core vendor of Sure's Falklands 2G/4G network: a local blog (openfalklands, S5, not cited) attributes it to Star Solutions (Canada), installed 2018; needs an S1/S2 source. Batelco's 2015 Star Solutions release covers only St Helena and Ascension.
Which AI provider or model FIDC's Project T-1000 pilots use, and the September 2026 first-phase report findings.
Whether Starlink commercial service actually launched in the Falklands after the late-2025 licence, and take-up.
Status of the National Broadband Strategy subsea cable study (openfalklands lead only) and any proposed cable route or supplier.
Whether the Intelsat/OneWeb backhaul arrangement continues after SES's acquisition of Intelsat; when Sure's exclusive licence expires.
Whether Stanley CCTV was ever procured after the October 2023 Police Committee discussion, and the vendor.
